item.title: New details in texts between Jane Doe and fraternity member
item.description: One accused fraternity member, later expelled, wrote to her: "I genuinely hope ur not catching as much heat from this as we r."

item.title: Vatican: Pope Leo's lung nodule surgery successful
item.description: The Vatican says Pope Leo XIV had successful surgery Tuesday to remove a lung nodule.

item.title: Tupac murder convict sentenced to 40 years to life
item.description: Duane "Keffe D" Davis was sentenced Tuesday in Las Vegas to 40 years to life for the 1996 murder of rapper Tupac Shakur.

item.title: Six Flags closes 9 more roller coasters after Georgia death
item.description: Six Flags shut down nine hypercoasters at six North American theme parks after a guest was killed at a Georgia park.
